title: Self-top-up versus direct recipient loading needs rewards-attribution verification
summary: Official published rules list eligible App/MyDITO load rewards at 0.5–4% by tier, no further points on load-balance-funded purchases, and free Share Load with transaction/day limits and a retained balance. These are published-policy observations, not verified account outcomes. Direct recipient purchase rewards attribution and this owner's tier remain unknown. The current checkout creates new recipient load; it does not implement Share Load. No payment or transfer was initiated.

evidence.description: Published earning rates and existing-load-balance exclusion, reviewed 2026-10-25.
Published Share Load limits: 5–1000 pesos per transfer, five daily transfers, at least one peso retained; reviewed 2026-10-25.
Current recipient checkout submits an external payment for new load, not a balance transfer.

nextSteps: Compare quoted total costs, the owner's rewards tier, and whose points/qualified-spend history is credited for an authorized direct-recipient purchase before recommending either route. Do not assume rewards twice for the same funds.
